background_story: Whitley was a majestic thoroughbred with a gleaming silver coat. However, his life wasn't always smooth sailing. As a young colt, Whitley suffered from recurring bouts of anxiety and nervousness, often resulting in poor performance on the track. His owner, a seasoned trainer, tried various remedies to calm Whitley's nerves. One day, she discovered the benefits of a bromide supplement, which helped to reduce Whitley's stress levels and promote relaxation. With his newfound calm, Whitley began to flourish, winning several prestigious racing titles and earning a reputation as a formidable competitor. Despite his success, Whitley remained humble, and his owner made sure to always prioritize his well-being, crediting the bromide supplement for helping to unlock his true potential.
